subject: Order Form: IP Notice Triage & Engineering Proof Request
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@acmeinc.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmeinc.com>, Mark Garcia <mark.garcia@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IP Notice / evidence we need for procurement sign-off

David / Kimberly —

Thanks for taking this on. Acme ran into a third‑party patent assertion tied to sample output from a pilot. Our procurement and legal teams need to confirm Redwood's notice and evidence process before we can finalize the order form. High‑level asks:

- Confirmation of notice window and escalation contact (who receives formal notices).
- A short list of the kinds of engineering artifacts you can supply (logs, model config, prompt bundles, KV cache snapshots) and the typical turnaround time.
- Any redlines you expect on the Order Form indemnity paragraph so our counsel can see the proposed language.

I've attached a short Acme evidence checklist for your intake team (acme_evidence_checklist.pdf). Procurement (Elena) is cc'd — she needs timing for commit/PO release. Mark, if you want to propose alternate wording up front, please add.

Appreciate quick confirmation — we have a procurement deadline next week.

—Sandeep
Senior Product Counsel | Acme, Inc.
[attachment: acme_evidence_checklist.pdf]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IP Notice / evidence we need for procurement sign-off

Sandeep / Elena —

Thanks, Sandeep. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

1) Notice routing and contact:
- Primary legal contact: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com).
- Ops contact for evidence intake: ben.carter@redwood.com (cc'd).
- We support standard written notice via email and DocuSign notice links; if a formal letter is required we can escalate.

2) Engineering artifacts we can provide (typical turnaround):
- Query + seed prompt bundle (24–48 hrs)
- Request/response logs (redacted) (48–72 hrs)
- Model config + quantization profile used for the run (48–72 hrs)
- Short KV cache snapshot extract (engineer discretion; 72 hrs)
- If requested: a minimal reproducible sample and inference trace (can take up to 5 business days)

3) Order Form indemnity redlines: we have a standard compromise we usually offer for IP third‑party claims (we'll send a tracked redline). Kimberly — can you attach the tracked language? I will also ask Ben to prepare the minimal technical snippet we can share now.

Ben — can you pull a single session trace and the prompt bundle for the sample in Acme's checklist? Attach as a text snippet (no secrets). If there's anything that needs legal review before sending, flag it and we'll coordinate with Kimberly.

Deliverables: draft redline doc + evidence snippet by end of day Wednesday 9/8. If Acme needs faster, tell Elena to mark the HubSpot deal and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Customer Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
[attachment: draft_order_form_redlines.docx]

To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Attached is a redacted text snippet from the session trace plus the prompt bundle referenced in the checklist. I removed any customer PII and internal loadbalancer traces. File: engineer_evidence_snippet.txt (see below for short contents).

From: Mark Garcia <mark.garcia@acmeinc.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmeinc.com>, Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@acmeinc.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form: IP Notice Triage & Engineering Proof Request

David / Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and Ben's snippet — that's helpful. A few notes from counsel at Acme: 

- We'll review the redline you sent and propose only narrow language to preserve Acme's indemnity expectations for third‑party infringement tied to customer content.
- Acme legal would like the explicit notice window and a commitment to provide the engineering artifacts listed within the 5‑business‑day window when reasonably requested (we can add a carveout for redaction).
- If Redwood is willing to commit to a named evidence liaison and a documented intake checklist (the attached PDF helps), that will remove a procurement blocker.

Please consider whether you can commit to the 5 business day SLA for artifacts (with caveat language). If so, we'll proceed to finalize the PO and route for signature.

Thanks — I'll wait for Kimberly's tracked redline and your confirmation on the artifact SLA.

Mark Garcia
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Acme, Inc.
[attachment: acme_evidence_checklist.pdf]
